text:
kevin_acme: hey @sophie_support — we're hitting a repeat/partial-chunk issue with the TS SDK streaming. App notices duplicate chunks after a client reconnect and token refresh; token billing spikes. Happened 3x in the last hour. request id: r-0ab12cd3

sophie_support: sorry to hear that. can you paste a minimal repro and the SDK version? also does this happen when you don't rotate the auth token?

kevin_acme: SDK @ 0.9.4, repro below. token rotation is intermittent but we reproduced without rotation too. minimal repro:

```ts
// simplified repro: client aborts and immediately reopens
const ctrl = new AbortController();
const s = await Redwood.stream({ model: 'x', prompt: 'hi' }, { signal: ctrl.signal });
// consume a few chunks then abort
setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 120);
// on abort we re-init and resume with same sessionId
await startNewStream({ sessionId: oldSession });
```

kevin_acme: logs show dup chunks and partial final frames. example excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-16T18:22:12.345Z] stream:open session=abc seq=42
[2026-03-16T18:22:12.520Z] stream:chunk seq=42 payload="hello wor"
[2026-03-16T18:22:12.521Z] client:abort signal
[2026-03-16T18:22:12.700Z] stream:resume session=abc seq_start=42
[2026-03-16T18:22:12.701Z] stream:chunk seq=42 payload="hello wor"
[2026-03-16T18:22:12.702Z] stream:chunk seq=43 payload="ld!"
```

sophie_support: thanks — assigning to runtime team. ajay, can you take a look? I flagged billing to finance.

ajay_runtime: looking. initial read — resume seems to re-emit buffered fragments without marking them consumed. sequence mapping on resume should advance an offset but looks like a race with abort handler. can you share request/response headers for the failing session?

kevin_acme: headers (sanitized):
```
Authorization: Bearer <token-redacted>\nX-Session-Id: abc\nUser-Agent: our-client/1.2.3\nX-Resume-Token: rtk-9xy\n```

ajay_runtime: aha, you include X-Resume-Token. current server path tries to reconcile resume token vs seq map. if abort happens between drain and commit, mapper might not ack the last delivered seq and replay.

sam_sre: quick mitigation for now: disable client-side resume and force a fresh session when you abort. config example: `stream.resumeOnAbort=false` or bump `resume_retries=0`. That avoids duplicate emission until we patch. We'll also credit the excess token usage for those request ids. :thumbsup:

kevin_acme: thanks — setting resumeOnAbort=false fixed immediate duplicates in our smoke. can you confirm root cause and timeline for a fix?

ajay_runtime: reproducer confirmed in our env with `X-Resume-Token` and rapid abort/reopen. Root cause: race in seq offset commit path — commit happens async and abort handler triggers a resume path that doesn't read the committed offset. Patch plan: 1) add atomic commit on abort + server-side dedupe check 2) stronger resume token check to require seq >= last_ack. PR planned today, internal ticket ENG-STREAM-789.

sophie_support: ENG-STREAM-789 created and assigned to ajay_runtime. ETA for rollout to staged infra: 48h. We'll run canary for 24h before global.

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered: eng/stream/patch/ENG-STREAM-789 -> staging at 2026-03-17T02:15:00Z

ajay_runtime: patch pushed to staging. please try enabling resumeOnAbort=false for prod until we finish canary. After canary we'll flip default to safe behavior (no replay of in-flight seqs).

kevin_acme: appreciated. finance confirmed a temporary credit for r-0ab12cd3 and two other requests. we'll monitor.

sophie_support: follow-up: can you run one more smoke with resumeOnAbort=false and post logs if you still see partial frames? if it's clean we'll close as mitigated and keep ENG-STREAM-789 open for the permanent fix.

kevin_acme: done. no dups after change, logs look clean. will report if anything else crops up. thanks everyone. :pray:

sophie_support: marking this thread as triaged. reopening if reoccurs.
